versions.changelog:
Initial beta release providing OSS data analysis through Alibaba Cloud AnalyticDB for MySQL Serverless:

- Validates all required inputs (endpoint/regionCode, workspaceId, oss:// URI, accessToken, analysis goal) together before processing.
- Supports both Hive metadata discovery and direct OSS file analysis, preferring metadata when available.
- Enforces safety by restricting SQL to single, read-only, bounded Presto statements.
- Handles credentials securely, never printing or persisting tokens and preferring explicit per-request tokens.
- Provides detailed error reporting, strict execution boundaries, and session-specific user-agent tagging for observability.
